primitives.verbatim_quote: Many a good in-field has no turf on it, and is called a "scalped" field.
primitives.assumptions: Uniform surface friction, constant air resistance, idealized projectile motion.

layer2.mapping: Ball trajectory model derived from field surface properties; used in GSI for probabilistic hit prediction.

primitives.verbatim_quote: To make a fair division of labor in laying out a field for immediate use, let three boys agree to furnish the iron staples, and posts (preferably of cedar) for the bases and pitcher's position, seven in all.

Trajectory regularization reflects how surface consistency improves predictability despite variability in initial conditions. These primitives form a dual structure: one describing physical interaction (kinematics), the other operational design (layout). Failure modes include misalignment of stakes leading to inconsistent base distances or insufficient surface preparation causing unpredictable bounces. Each primitive contributes to a layered system where GSI infers probabilistic outcomes while GSE navigates discrete state transitions based on these constraints.
